end_to_end.expected: With puts failing, unticking shows the role=alert message, the toggle is ticked again, the IndexedDB settings record still equals the defaults, and a new game shows all 5 style labels; with puts working, unticking shows no message, the record becomes showOpponentStyles:false and a new game shows no style labels.
end_to_end.actual: Observed exactly that in both browsers: alert text 'Your change could not be saved, so the setting is unchanged.', toggle checked, record == defaults, 5 style labels at the table; after a working untick no alert, record false, 0 style labels.

findings.expected_vs_actual: A-3 says the message clears when the next change is made (not when it saves). Observed behaviour matches (flag is cleared synchronously in changeSettings), but neither the builder's e2e nor any test distinguishes clear-on-change from clear-on-success because writes settle within milliseconds.
